name: The Interested Indian — host
_comment: Single source of truth for the host's identity. Consumed by the character generator, the visual router and the image QA rubric so they cannot drift apart. review_images.py previously hardcoded 'chubby round cartoon character with short stubby arms', which would fail every image of this design. Nothing here changes without a version bump and a fresh approval.

orientation_convention.definition: All left/right references are SUBJECT-relative, not viewer-relative.
orientation_convention.subject-left: the character's own left; appears on the viewer's right
orientation_convention.subject-right: the character's own right; appears on the viewer's left

identity.summary: A stylized Indian male investigative explainer in his late twenties. Intelligent, curious, approachable and occasionally humorous. Youthful proportions but unmistakably adult, with confident posture and expressive editorial-cartoon features.
identity.prompt_block: A stylized young Indian male explainer in his late twenties, with warm medium-brown skin, a rounded rectangular face with a slightly elongated mature lower face, a defined adult jaw and neck, large dark-brown eyes, thick black eyebrows, a small rounded nose, and a distinctive layered, swept-up black hair crest with broad tapered locks and a stable outer silhouette. He wears perfectly round gold-rimmed glasses. His signature outfit is an ivory kurta with a short standing collar and three small dark buttons on the placket, matching loose off-white trousers, and dark brown open-toe leather sandals. Adult proportions: head roughly one-seventh of total height, shoulders clearly wider than the head, natural adult limb length. Clean dark outlines, restrained cel shading, warm cream-and-navy editorial illustration style.

immutable: layered swept-up black hair crest with a stable outer silhouette
ivory kurta with standing collar and three dark buttons
negative_prompt: no beard, no moustache, no stubble, no hat, no earrings, no wristwatch, no bag, no changed eyewear shape, no rimless or square glasses, no alternate hairstyle, no costume change, no childlike or chibi proportions, no oversized head, no photorealism, no 3D render, no anime style, no children's picture-book style, no painterly background, no text, no watermark, no extra people, no extra fingers
_negative_prompt_note: 'no cropped hands or feet' is deliberately NOT here — it contradicts waist-up portraits and head-and-shoulders expressions. It is applied only to full-body framings, via negative_prompt_by_framing.

rules: flat base colours with restrained soft cel shading; no glossy, photorealistic or dramatic gradients
clean dark navy outlines of even weight
consistent eye highlight: single small dot upper-right of each iris

body_master.role: AUTHORITY for full-body identity, clothing, body proportions and sandals.
body_master.reason: the current body master still contains the superseded younger v1 face; metadata cannot stop an image model averaging it with v3, and the three-quarter drift shows the risk is real

references_used.note: source has since been archived and prohibited as an anchor

history.role: AUTHORITY for clothing, body proportions and sandals. NOT an authority for the face — its v1 face is younger than approved.
history.superseded_reason: contained the younger v1 face; metadata alone could not stop an image model averaging it with v3

face_master.role: AUTHORITY for face, hair, glasses and age. Anchor for every expression and for the face in any waist-up or full-body view.
face_master.generation_mode: images.edit (dual reference: body_master + face master v2)

history.superseded_reason: hair volume, multi-ring glasses, face width

face_master_brief.framing: square, front-facing, symmetrical head-and-shoulders, face large enough to serve as the expression reference
face_master_brief.expression: neutral with a relaxed mouth — not a pronounced smile
face_master_brief._note: v3 is a controlled refinement of v2, not a redesign. Two references are supplied: the body master for hair/glasses/overall identity, and face master v2 for the mature jaw, neck, eye size and close-up detail.
corrections: hair: reduce total crest height and volume by about 15-20 percent, returning closer to the body master's dense overlapping swept-up silhouette; locks must overlap and flow together rather than reading as individually separated sculpted leaves; preserve the recognizable upward sweep
glasses: match the body master's thinner, simple gold circular rims; remove the heavy concentric multi-ring appearance; keep perfectly round lenses and the same bridge position
face width: narrow the cheeks and overall face width by about 5-8 percent while preserving the mature jaw angle and neck width; do not return to the soft childlike v1 jaw

planned_next_package.note: Face master v3 IS the neutral expression — do not regenerate it.

master_authority.rule: Full-body AND upper-torso pose generations must receive BOTH approved masters. Angle references may guide orientation only and must never replace either master or supply identity.

generation_rules.no_fallback: Never fall back to single-reference or unanchored generation. Fail loudly instead — a silent fallback reintroduces the v1 face.

usable_for: orientation and angle guidance when generating new poses
not_usable_for: direct reuse as a waist-up pose asset
angle_references.note: Framing is chest-up rather than true waist-up. The profile's 56.3% head fraction is an accepted exception and will not be re-rendered.

integrated_body_brief.framing: front-facing, neutral, full body, complete hands and feet visible
